R5622.summary: Written from Paris during the Fronde, the despatch concerns opposition to Cardinal Mazarin's return to France: the Parlement's death sentence and 150,000-livre bounty, threats against Mazarin, and an appeal for papal intervention. The nuncio rejects the Parlement's jurisdiction over a cardinal; a speaker tentatively identified as the Duke of Orléans threatens that Mazarin will be killed in his cardinal's robes unless the pope summons or deprives him.
R5622.en:
R5622 - Niccolo Guidi di Bagno, nuncio in France, to Cardinal Chigi. Paris, 5 January 1652.
English translation of the deciphered text (Claude, with Astra's proposals checked; 2026-10-20, round 5,
with Astra's translation corrections).
Basis: the line-by-line reading in R5622readingeditionclaude.txt and edited\ in the CTTS project.
[...] = not read; (?) = tentative; [code: value?] = word or name code with a tentative identification.
Words in square brackets without a code are supplied for sense.

[f. 6r]
Two days after the departure of the last ordinary [post], with which I informed Your Eminence of the
resolution taken in the Parlement against Mazarin, the arrêt was printed; I send it to Your Eminence with
the present letter. It contains the death penalty and the bounty of one hundred and fifty thousand livres
placed on his head. It declares him [2149: to have?]
